title: AURA — Sound, shaped around you
sourcePrompt: Create a 20-second cinematic launch film for a fictional premium wireless headphone. Make it tactile, restrained and memorable, without inventing product specs.
objective: Build desire by revealing the product's tactile design and presence rather than listing features.
audience: Design-conscious consumers who respond to premium product craft.
desiredResponse: Remember the headphone silhouette and associate it with thoughtful craftsmanship.
creativeThesis: Reveal the headphone through material, sound and controlled movement; each shot uncovers one layer of identity until a confident hero frame.

visualLanguage.typography: Restrained editorial sans-serif; short uppercase copy only when needed.
visualLanguage.composition: Asymmetric macro crops evolving into a balanced three-quarter hero composition with deliberate negative space.
visualLanguage.lighting: Soft directional key with narrow edge highlights and rich but readable shadows.
visualLanguage.texture: Brushed metal, satin polymer, soft-touch ear cushions and fine acoustic perforations.

storytellingStrategy: Open on a concealed material detail; progressively reveal the silhouette, one tactile interface detail, an expressive exploded view and then the complete headphone. Use visible visual progression rather than feature cards.
motionLanguage: Slow macro push, a restrained orbit, a lateral detail move and a final camera move that settles into a still hero. Cuts follow shape and highlight continuity.
soundIdentity: Minimal original electronic pulse with tactile Foley, one quiet control click and a restrained final impact. No voice-over.
productionMethodStrategy: Use one custom Three.js/Remotion composition with shot-specific camera paths and procedural headphone geometry. Keep all imagery, music and Foley original; do not assume paid or hosted generation services.
constraints: No fabricated specifications, endorsements or testimonials.
Use original assets and record their provenance.
Keep copy short and inside safe areas.
assumptions: AURA and the headphone are fictional and created only for this visual benchmark.
The stylized 3D model is illustrative, not a depiction of a real commercial product.
The 20-second duration and 16:9 delivery are fixed.
acceptanceCriteria: The headphone silhouette is fully revealed by the end of the second shot.
At least four distinct visual scales or compositions are used.
Every shot has a visible action or visual progression.
The product design remains coherent across all shots.
The final hero shot holds for at least two seconds and resolves the opening material motif.
Original music and Foley support the edit without narration or unsupported product claims.
